WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.transref,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS x
    ON s.transref = x.transreg
  JOIN trader AS t
    ON x.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind
),
with_deviation AS (
  SELECT
    transref,
    tradekind,
    avg_optvolrt,
    ABS(avg_optvolrt - (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) FROM sentimentandfundamentals)) AS deviation
  FROM pair_averages
),
with_excess AS (
  SELECT
    transref,
    tradekind,
    avg_optvolrt,
    deviation,
    deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS excess
  FROM with_deviation
  WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
),
qualifying_pairs AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM with_excess
  WHERE excess > 0
)
SELECT
  tradekind,
  AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS average_option_volume_ratio,
  AVG(deviation) AS average_deviation,
  AVG(excess) AS average_excess
FROM qualifying_pairs
GROUP BY tradekind;
